title: Setup in a shared repo keeps relay out of the team's files
what: In a repository other people also use, relay setup writes relay's project settings (enabled relay plugins, marketplace) where they do not reach the team (for example .claude/settings.local.json, which git does not track), so a teammate without relay does not get "plugin not found". Design when taken: how setup knows a repo is shared, what stays committed.
why: Found 26 Oct while answering the owner's question "Как после будут подключаться новые проекты": setup writes relay's plugins into the project's .claude/settings.json, which is committed to the project's repo. Connecting Glonass repositories stays deferred (owner, 25 Oct). IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
where: lib/relay_setup.py what setup writes into a project's .claude/settings.json
